For fixing I suggest to replace the RAFI display middle segment, however I would like to have more details about the issue. Some inspection and pictures would help in this case.
If this is a possible "factory issue", I need to understand better the context of how was this found.
You said you found the issue in a inspection. Was this inspection done with the charger in the warehouse or after installation?
Was the issue reported in the commissioning report?
The other charger with the same problem, did you create a ticket about it?
